title: OpenBrain Sync Undo Record
description: Written as <batch_id>.undo.json under 10_memory/staging/batches/ before the first destination of an approved batch is written. It carries the whole prior content of every target the batch will touch, byte for byte, which is what lets `open-brain sync undo` restore the vault exactly as it was before the batch was applied. Immutable once written: a resume reuses the original record instead of snapshotting a half-applied vault.

targetSnapshot.title: State of one file before the batch touched it

existed.description: Whether the target existed on disk before the batch.

sha256.description: Null exactly when existed is false.

bytes.description: Null exactly when existed is false.

content.description: The whole file content before the batch, kept whole so undo can restore it. Null exactly when existed is false.
